Functional Requirements Summary: FR-1: Every three-seed validation run uses exactly four shards; run_seeds.sh no longer takes a shard count
FR-2: LoL replay, results, wallet, and summaries use the last livestats frame and engine PnL; no forced-hold or cutoff accounting
FR-3: Canonical prediction loads one model.txt; bank.json cannot redirect it
FR-4: Dota prepare/train is fixed at 300s on minute rows -60..540 with no horizon/window tooling
FR-5: One Dota prepare writes research + production datasets; one Dota train publishes research then production
FR-6: LoL Stage 05/06 is fixed at 300s, seconds 0..540, stride 1, canonical paths, research then production
FR-7: Backtest has one queue/join policy and no strategy/model-path knobs; cadence seed remains
FR-8: Live keeps only real per-game differences and the restart-mismatch emergency exit; no clock unwind or size ramp
FR-9: Authoritative docs match the frozen pipeline; historical experiment reports keep evidence but not keep-tooling verdicts
Resolved Questions: Execute the three 2026-09-03 plans in order: four-shard launcher, LoL forced-hold removal, then collapse-canonical-pipeline-optionality Tasks 1–7.
The two sibling plans are one user step each; the collapse plan's seven Tasks are seven user steps.
Do not run full prepare/train/backtest jobs. Focused tests, CLI help, make test, and make lint-all are the verification boundary.
Preserve unrelated working-tree changes in dota_2_model, including the existing .streamlit/config.toml deletion and docs/next_steps.md.
No compatibility shims for removed CLI flags. Old commands fail argument parsing.
Keep --signal-cadence-seed, operational backtest flags, onchain_fills vs trades, LoL Stage 05 --workers/--accept-audit, and research vs production artifact separation.
Non-Goals (Out of Scope for V1): Full prepare, train, or validation backtest jobs
Live LoL mode switch or VPS deploys
Compatibility shims for deleted flags, bank.json, or old result columns beyond ignoring extra parquet fields
